title: Voices of Courage Breakfast of Champions
beneficiary: Voices of Courage Child Advocacy Center
summary: A morning to recognize community champions and support children and families through Voices of Courage Child Advocacy Center.
description: Start the morning with people making a difference for children and families. Join us for breakfast, community recognition, and support for Voices of Courage Child Advocacy Center.
Knot-4-Profit Collaborations is organizing the event. Voices of Courage Child Advocacy Center is the benefiting organization, supporting children and families affected by abuse.
Find current ticket and table options through Zeffy. Businesses and individuals interested in sponsorship can explore opportunities through the event’s sponsorship form.

title: Pony Express 5K
beneficiary: St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, through the Measly Mile Mafia Heroes
summary: A community run supporting St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, with Knot-4-Profit Collaborations participating as a Silver Sponsor.
description: The Pony Express 5K brought runners together in St. Joseph on June 6, 2026, in support of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital through the Measly Mile Mafia Heroes.
Knot-4-Profit Collaborations participated as a Silver Sponsor. The race’s official RunSignup page is the source for race information and any future editions.

title: Hurts Donuts for St. Jude
beneficiary: St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, through the Measly Mile Mafia Heroes
summary: A sweet way to support St. Jude. Knot-4-Profit helped facilitate a Hurts Donuts fundraiser for the Measly Mile Mafia Heroes’ campaign.
description: A box of donuts became a way to support a shared cause. The May 8, 2026 fundraiser offered Hurts Donuts for pickup at River Bluff Brewing in St. Joseph.
Knot-4-Profit Collaborations helped facilitate the fundraiser, supporting the Measly Mile Mafia Heroes’ New York Marathon campaign for St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital.
This fundraiser has ended. Its original event page remains available for background information.
